data.description:
Gwen, an ancient doll transformed and brought to life by magic, wields the same tools that once created her. She carries the weight of her From the Maker From the Maker loves with every step, taking nothing for granted. At her command is the Sacred Mist, an ancient and protective magic that has blessed Gwen's scissors, needles, and sewing thread. Much is new to her, but Gwen remains joyfully determined to fight for the good that survives in a broken world. Gwen was originally created as a doll by a seamstress named Isolde, embodying her desire for adventure and royalty. Isolde loved her doll dearly and spent hours sewing and playing with it. Eventually, Isolde would be courted by Viego, the king of Camavor, and she would no longer have time to play with her beloved doll. At first, Gwen could feel that Viego made his creator happy, but their love would sour and turn painful. Isolde would fall ill due to an assassin's blade and eventually pass away. Viego brought Isolde's corpse to the Blessed Isles in hopes of reviving her, but instead unleashed ruin. Without its king, the nation of Camavor would crumble and Gwen would be forgotten for centuries. The Ruined King would somehow escape the amulet and resume his search for his queen. Fragments of Isolde's soul scattered across Runeterra and embedded themselves in various shackles, one of them being Gwen. Gwen would be brought back to life by Isolde's soul fragment and would find herself with a pair of scissors, needles, and oversized thread. She would soon be attacked by a swarm of wights and remembered the pain associated with Viego, quickly dispatching the wights and knowing that they were bound with him. Fascinated by the wonders of life, Gwen would set out to explore the world and stop the pain caused by Viego and the Black Mist. After the defeat of the Ruined King, Gwen continued to clear the black mist in the Shadow Isles.
Gwen is a doll brought to life by the Sacred Mist and a fragment of Isolde's soul. She represents her kindness, love, and joy, granting her self-awareness and an independent personality. Talents and Abilities
Magically Altered Physiology: Gwen's body is magically altered and extremely unique due to the circumstances of her birth. Although she was initially a doll created by Isolde, her creator has granted her full life thanks to the magic of the Sacred Mist, and she is undoubtedly considered human to a certain extent. She can also revert to a doll at will.
Sacred Mist Manipulation: Having received life and the blessing of the cursed Black Mist's holy opposite, Gwen is capable of manipulating this mist with multiple powers. The Sacred Mist's primary function is to protect herself and others within its cloud, virtually concealing and immunizing them from external dangers. Those under the influence of the Sacred Mist tend to feel a sense of comfort and calm when it envelops them. As the antithesis of the Black Mist, Gwen has demonstrated that she can use it to banish and protect any undead affected by it, being strong enough to imprison the Ruined King himself.
Holy Mist Constructs: Gwen can manipulate the Holy Mist into various forms, usually sewing materials and common tools. With these constructs, Gwen can attack her enemies, especially the undead.
Enchanting: Gwen can use the Holy Mist to enchant and strengthen other objects to make them more capable of combating the Black Mist. She can use it to create new items, such as the numerous outfits she created for the Sentinels of Light, which she sewed with threads from the mist itself, or to enchant common items, as she did with her signature scissors.
Scissor Proficiency: Gwen often uses giant enchanted scissors in combat, which she has enchanted with the Holy Mist. Gwen wields these scissors with ease, capable of swiftly slicing through entire groups of enemies. Additionally, Gwen has demonstrated the ability to manipulate the scissors with her mind, telekinetically moving them and allowing them to cut enemies without touching them. She can also alter the size of her scissors at will.
Sewing Mastery: As a doll created by Isolde, who was already talented at sewing, Gwen is a supernaturally gifted seamstress. Her manipulation of the Sacred Mist directly reflects her seamstress talents, and she can create entire, intricate outfits almost instantly with enough fabric and materials, just as she did with the Sentinels of Light.
A Thousand Cuts: Each cut she makes in combat helps her heal.
Slash, Slash!: Gwen performs at least two to ten slashes with her scissors in a cone in the target direction, dealing magic damage per cut to all enemies within the area. The final cut deals increased damage. Holy Mist: Gwen summons the Holy Mist at her current location, and she cannot be attacked by any enemy at range, forcing them to move closer to her. Gwen commands the mist to move to her current location.
Jump and Slash: Gwen dashes to the target location and then powers up her attacks.
Stitch: Gwen throws a needle in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and slowing them.
